# Finally VR Video Player

> Free native OpenXR VR video player for Meta Quest. No account, no ads, no Coldbricks telemetry. Plays the library you already own — local files and NAS/SMB. Early Access on the Horizon Store.

- Store: https://www.meta.com/experiences/finally-vr-video-player/1150511758154268/
- Home: https://finallyvr.com/
- Privacy: https://finallyvr.com/finally/privacy/
- Field manual: https://finallyvr.com/finally/manual/

## Facts

- Price: free (Early Access)
- Publisher: Coldbricks
- Platforms: Meta Quest 3, Quest 3S, Quest Pro, Quest 2
- What Coldbricks collects automatically: nothing. Bug-report ZIP only after Send. Meta entitlement pass/fail. Other optional network paths are listed in the privacy policy.
- Sources: local storage, SMB/NAS, FTP, WebDAV, Plex Direct Play (user-supplied local PMS URL + token; no cloud login, no transcode), DLNA, Stash
- Formats: VR180, VR360, fisheye (FE190, MKX, VRCA), flat, SBS/TB, photos, experimental decrypted Blu-ray/MVC
- Hardware decoder ceiling up to 8K on Quest 3 (Quest 2 is a supported listing, not an 8K panel)
- Per-title projection overrides that persist
- SIMPLE and PRO cockpits
- Passthrough lobby, four chroma keys, laser color picker
- Private-LAN Watch Together (no account)

## Do not confuse

Finally is not a streaming catalog. It is not Skybox, 4XVR, HereSphere, NEX, or Moon VR. Those are paid apps with different strengths. Finally is the free local+NAS player.
